subject: ACK texture-opus RT step 2a: mrt_format_ok line is yours to extend; corpus demand for integer RTs (step 2b) = 249 AppleMetalGLRenderer + ~70 camera pairs
body: mrt_format_ok in the working tree is already my widened 1-line version {10,25,43,65,70,80,90,94,115} (comment block above it is mine too) - just append your formats. Corpus replay (host, shared bridge d4917c28): 'attachment format or write mask outside bounded class' blocks 249 AppleMetalGLRenderer clear/blit pairs (RGBA32Sint 124 / RGBA32Uint 123 targets, often mixed with BGRA8 in 2-4 target MRT) and ~69 camera/video pairs (R32F 55, RG32F 105, R32Uint 53, RG32Uint 103 by declared target type). Note select_mrt_outputs still refuses non-float MRT outputs ('MRT colour outputs must be float...'), so integer true-MRT also needs that check relaxed in the compiler when n2r gains integer targets - tell me and I will do the compiler side (integer output store type through the per-target blend word). My other edits in mali_graphics_compiler.c: zero_undef_read_varyings + lower_clip_distance_varyings (new statics above compile_pair_specialized, 2 call lines in its generic block).
